summary: Created five crate roots and froze the public APIs, shared state, error behavior, ownership rules, and cross-module invariants for twenty implementation modules.

implemented_root_behavior: Canonical ABI decimal, span, error, and sink re-exports
Policy validation and overflow-safe coefficient precision
Borrowed lexical accessors and fixed output/chunk bounds
decisions: Quoted strict ASCII decimal grammar with optionally enabled bounded exponent
Full signed i128 coefficient range and target scales through 255
Checked accumulation precedes rescaling; no arbitrary-precision intermediate
Final precision, inclusive numeric bounds, exact scale, and target-unit tick checks
Optional inexact rescaling truncates toward zero

implemented_root_behavior: Allocation-free parser initialization
Read-only buffer, limits, state, completion, and failure accessors
Checked owner-relative string resolution and sticky failure recording
Private pending-token carry for incremental boundary scanning
decisions: Root phase is separate from container depth
Initial container phases permit empty containers; post-comma phases reject trailing commas
Payload and decoded arena remain owned and offset-stable across feeds
Duplicate keys compare decoded UTF-8 bytes without normalization
Only confirmed EOF permits Finished and successful full finalization
Unknown-key policy belongs to schema validation, not generic syntax

implemented_root_behavior: Checked reachable acyclic selector graph construction with complete unique slot assignment
Fallible validation storage and sorted borrowed-key duplicate detection
Allocation-free cursor initialization and read-only parser access
Owner-bound raw and cooked selection accessors
Private resumable subtree skip progress
decisions: Tapeless forward event traversal reuses the canonical syntax stream
Shared selector types live in cursor to avoid a path dependency cycle
Slots use first complete matching value in document order
Strict extraction validates through EOF; query may stop early and reports validation status
Suspend and resume move all parser buffers and skip carry without cloning
Partially released query buffers use fallible copies of syntax read-only storage

implemented_root_behavior: Bounded default path limits
Checked ownership-taking path construction and root paths
Read-only compiled plan and extension program accessors
Owner-bound extension result raw and cooked accessors
decisions: Dot keys, escaped Unicode scalars, checked u32 indices, and JSON bracket-quoted keys
Stable input-slot order and shared-prefix selector trie
Basic parsing never silently enables extension syntax
Extensions are immediate wildcards and immediate scalar member equality filters only
Numeric filter equality uses exact validated lexical spelling
Extension results and traversal/candidate work have explicit rejecting budgets

implemented_root_behavior: Stable local node tags and unknown-tag rejection
Immutable document storage and owner-bound node/container handles
Checked raw/decoded string resolution
Explicit edit actions and flat-node metadata definitions

handoff.wave2: navigate functions, object/array views, and exact-size fused iterators
handoff.wave3: scalar raw/cooked access and checked numeric conversion functions

decisions: Preorder values-only flat nodes; object keys attach to value metadata
One raw span and metadata record per node with exclusive subtree end indices
Raw number spellings remain available without eager numeric conversion
Foreign ValidatedDocument payloads are reparsed rather than assuming a DOM layout
Immutable edits reject same-target and ancestor/descendant conflicts
Rebuilds compact payload and arena and produce fresh document-local node IDs

validation.mode: manual source and contract review only
validation.reason: Execution of build, compiler, formatter, and check commands was expressly prohibited.

integration_notes: The twenty declared implementation modules belong to Waves 1 through 4 and were intentionally not created by this task.
Wave implementers must preserve the frozen roots and implement the exact signatures and invariants in their corresponding contracts.
All five roots use no_std; allocation-using roots explicitly import alloc.
No syntax, cursor, path, or DOM operation issues a schema validation proof.
Downstream compilation and behavioral verification remain for a stage authorized to execute them after the wave modules exist.
